Alaska.Ai — The Stack Draft

2026-06-15 · branch claude/linkedin-stack-2026-06-15
No defensible target this cycle.
The Stack ran the full seven-point anti-confabulation gate on all 11 candidate mechanisms across the 14-day window (June 1–15, 2026) and the broadened 21-day window (May 25–June 15, 2026). Zero mechanisms cleared all seven gates. No post or image was produced. This is a correct outcome; the bar was not lowered.

Mapper Validation Note

The 14-day window (June 1–15, 2026) yielded three candidates with in-window news triggers. Zero passed all seven gates. The window was broadened to 21 days (May 25–June 15) per protocol. Zero passed all seven gates in the 21-day window either. Dominant failure mode: Gate 5 (chokepoint asymmetry). Mechanisms with valid news ties and verifiable layer chains (GCI cable break, GVEA pricing) both have multi-actor or physical/environmental chokepoints rather than a single named institutional officer with a binary decision. The RCA is a 5-member commission; the repair vessel constraint is environmental. Second failure mode: Gate 1 paraphrase drift — AO 2026-27's trigger article (June 9 RFLP story) does not name the mechanism it purports to trigger. Gate 1 requires the trigger article to make the mechanism visible. The APFC IPS trigger is an institutional self-announcement, not independent editorial coverage. No candidate passes all seven gates after applying both windows. This is a correct no-target outcome. The bar was not lowered. Recommendation for next cycle: surface mechanisms with single administrative law judge decisions, single contracting officer award decisions, or single-signature permit approvals — these will be more likely to pass Gate 5 than rate cases, board votes, or market-driven physical constraints.

Editor’s Note — Deviations This Run

Window broadening: 14-day window (June 1–15) applied first; yielded zero survivors. Broadened to 21 days (May 25–June 15) per protocol. Still zero survivors. No subagent stalled (all four scouts and the mapper completed normally). No image was rendered (no target). No post was written. Gmail draft built without gmail_draft.py (that script requires post and image files that do not exist on a no-target run) — HTML payload built directly instead. Dominant failure mode: Gate 5 (chokepoint asymmetry). Mechanisms that otherwise had verifiable layers and in-window triggers (GCI Aleutians cable break, GVEA power pricing stack) both had multi-actor or environmental/physical chokepoints rather than a single named institutional officer holding a binary decision. Recommendation for next cycle: prioritize mechanisms with single contracting officer awards, single administrative law judge decisions, or single-signature permit approvals rather than commission rate cases, board votes, or weather-gated physical constraints.
